svg.text: Origami for Kids · Project #08 · Butterfly · Steps 9–11 · page 3/3 (1:1 scale)
PRINT AT 100% / ACTUAL SIZE — Do NOT “fit to page”
The waterbomb base is a function
Steps 1–5 always make the same triangle. Origami folders call it the WATERBOMB BASE.
A paper balloon, a jumping frog, a lily and this butterfly all start with it.
In code that is a function: write the steps once, give them a name, use them again.
• Hold the fold underneath between finger and thumb. Let the wings fall open.
• Pinch gently and let go, again and again: the wings flap.
• Wings too floppy? Press the middle fold (step 10) harder.
• Fold a tiny butterfly from a 75 mm square. Same steps — same function, smaller input!
• Plain paper? Draw your own spots after step 9. Make left and right match: symmetry.
Measure: this bar must be exactly 100 mm. Print at 100%, not "fit to page".
